verdict.rationale: Human annotation queues are a fair question for an LLM observability platform like Helicone, but nothing in the evidence documents routing outputs to human review or labeling queues. Webhooks for automated scoring and request export are only developer building blocks a user could wire to an external labeling tool, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling
